About the role
Help customers in Asia Pacific put Acme AI models into daily operations. You will not write production code; you will configure, test and roll out solutions with customer teams.

- Lead deployments with enterprise customers from pilot to rollout
- Turn customer feedback into product requests
You may be a good fit if you have
- 4+ years of customer-facing technical delivery or operations work
- Comfort explaining technical trade-offs to non-technical leaders
Strong candidates may also have
- Experience in logistics, retail or operations-heavy industries
This role is based in Sydney. Relocation support is available within Australia.
